design: All source, validation, and test origins fixed at t=64. Crop only context; identical future labels and folds across lengths. Fresh pretrained head for each length/fold/LR. Lock all 12 heads before test inference.
selection: Validation SOH loss only; step zero allowed. Reject candidates whose raw decile crossing or q10>q90 fraction over all 256 validation forecast positions exceeds step zero. Lock all 12 heads before test inference. No test-driven hyperparameter search.
loss: Native 21-quantile pinball loss in context-normalized/arcsinh space, mean over finite targets per cell, sum over quantiles, mean over source cells. Verified against native forward loss scaled per cell by H/observed_count.
eol_definition: First eligible measured capacity <= 1.4 Ah; event is absorbing. No interpolation. Three consecutive values are a label sensitivity diagnostic only.
censoring: No observed EOL: report RUL > last eligible cycle - t; no exact RUL error. No forecast crossing within H: report predicted RUL > H, not H. Show non-hit counts alongside conditional finite-case errors and all-case error lower bounds.
diagnostics: Same H256 trajectories scored in prefixes 16/32/64/128/256 and disjoint bands 1-16/17-32/33-64/65-128/129-256, eligible observations only through EOL or censoring. Missing future labels remain unscored. Pointwise quantiles are not RUL intervals.
limitations: Exploratory NASA four-cell study, three observed EOLs, single seed. No optimal input selected using test RUL. No smoothing, monotonic projection, extra extrapolation, or future measured input.
hardware: All three contexts freshly inferred and fitted on identical desktop CUDA; old XPU L64 is a diagnostic reference only.
